title: Smoked Pork Tagine Tacos
description: A fusion of Mexican and Slovakian flavors, this dish combines the rich flavors of smoked pork with the warmth of traditional Slovakian spices, served in a crispy taco shell.

ingredients.name: Smoked Pork Shoulder
ingredients.notes: Look for a piece with a thick layer of fat

ingredients.name: Slovakian Paprika
ingredients.notes: A mild, sweet paprika that adds depth to the dish

ingredients.name: Warm Cumin
ingredients.notes: Add a warm, earthy flavor to the pork

ingredients.name: Tagine Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: A blend of spices that typically includes cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

ingredients.name: Lime Juice
ingredients.notes: Add a squeeze of fresh lime juice for brightness

ingredients.name: Cilantro
ingredients.notes: Add a fresh, herbaceous flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: Taco Shells
ingredients.notes: Crisp, crunchy taco shells to hold the filling

ingredients.name: Sour Cream
ingredients.notes: A tangy, creamy topping to balance the flavors

ingredients.name: Diced Onions
ingredients.notes: Add a sweet, caramelized flavor to the dish

instructions: Season the smoked pork shoulder with Slovakian paprika, warm cumin, and tagine spice blend.
Place the pork in a Dutch oven or oven-safe pot and cover with a lid.
Braise the pork in the oven for 2-3 hours, or until tender and easily shredded with a fork.
Shred the pork with two forks and stir in lime juice and chopped cilantro.
Warm the taco shells according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the pork mixture into the shells, followed by a dollop of sour cream and diced onions.
